blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Novel view synthesis from sparse images must reconcile faithful reconstruction of observed regions with plausible completion of unseen content, while maintaining world consistency across viewpoints.
Existing geometry-based methods preserve observed scene structure but often struggle to complete unseen regions, whereas video generative models offer rich appearance priors but accumulate inconsistencies during sequential view generation.
We propose GeoVerse, a framework that synthesizes world-consistent novel views by performing generation within the geometric latent space of a pretrained 3D foundation model and injecting appearance priors from a video generative model.
Specifically, GeoVerse extracts multilevel features from Wan2.2 VACE and injects them into the geometric latent diffusion model via a ControlNet-style adapter, incorporating video-learned appearance priors to enhance structural completion.
To enforce cross-view coherence, a global spatial memory continuously aggregates observed and synthesized content, reprojecting target-aligned guidance to anchor subsequent predictions to a shared scene representation.
Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate improved visual quality and geometric consistency, with a 2.23 dB higher PSNR on DL3DV and 32.4% lower ATE on Mip-NeRF360 compared to GLD.
blocks.zh:
从稀少的图像中合成小说,必须调和被观测区域的忠实重建与可能完成的无形内容,同时保持世界各种观点的一致性。
现有的几何学方法保留了观测到的场景结构,但往往难以完成看不见的区域,而视频基因模型提供了丰富的外观前传,但在相继的视图生成过程中却积累了不一致.
我们提出GeoVerse这个框架,通过在预先训练的3D基础模型的几何潜在空间内表演一代以及从视频基因模型中注入外观前缀来综合世界一致的新观点。
具体地说,GeoVerse从Wan2.2 VACE中提取多层特征,并通过ControlNet式的适配器将其注入几何潜扩散模型,其中包含了视频学习的外观前科,以提高结构的完成性.
为了实现交叉视野的一致性,一个全球空间内存不断聚合观测和合成内容,将目标对齐的指南重新投影,将后续的预测定位到一个共享的场景代表.
各种数据集的广泛实验显示,视觉质量和几何一致性都有所提高,DL3DV上的PSNR比2.23 dB高,Mip-NERF360上的ATE比GLD低32.4%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Novel View Synthesis (NVS) is a cornerstone task in 3D computer vision that aims to render photorealistic images from specified, previously unseen target viewpoints given one or more reference images ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ; Yu et al., 2024a ) .
A fundamental challenge in NVS lies in balancing reconstruction fidelity during view interpolation with generative capability during view extrapolation, faithfully aggregating observed scene content while plausibly completing unobserved regions.
To bridge faithful reconstruction with generative completion, maintaining a unified geometric representation is crucial for ensuring spatial and semantic coherence across shifting viewpoints.
blocks.zh:
小说视图合成(NVS)是3D计算机视觉中的一项基石任务,旨在从指定的,先前未见的目标角度将照片现实化的图像提供给一个或多个参考图像(Mildenhall等人,2021年;Yu等人,2024a年)。
在NVS中,一个根本的挑战是在视图插图期间平衡重建的忠诚度,在视图插图期间平衡基因能力,忠实地汇总观测到的场景内容,同时合理完成无法观察的区域。
为了将忠实的重建与基因的完成联系起来,保持统一的几何代表性对于确保不断变化的观点之间的空间和语义一致性至关重要。

blocks.en:
Early NVS frameworks were predominantly constrained to per-scene optimization, with pioneering paradigms like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) fitting scene-specific representations on dense captures.
To bypass scene-specific training bottlenecks, recent generalizable architectures leverage scaled data to predict Gaussian primitives directly from sparse views in a feed-forward manner ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025a ) .
Spurred by 3D foundation models ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , these feed-forward methods achieve rapid feed-forward reconstruction with strong geometry grounding ( Jiang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) .
However, bound by deterministic geometric formulations, pure reconstruction frameworks inherently lack generative imagination, frequently producing severe visual artifacts, blurriness, or hollow voids when synthesizing unobserved regions under large camera motions.
blocks.zh:
早期的NVS框架主要受限于每个场景优化,其开创性范式有神经辐射场(NERF)(Mildenhall等人,2021年)和3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)(Kerbl等人,2023年)在密集捕捉上配上场景特定表现.
为了绕过场景特异性的训练瓶颈,近期的通俗化建筑利用尺度化的数据,直接从稀疏的视野中预测高斯原始人,向前进(Chen等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2025a).
由3D基础模型(王等人,2024年;王等人,2025a)推导而成,这些饲料推进方法实现了快速的饲料推进重建,并具有强烈的几何定位(江等人,2025a;刘等人,2025年).
然而,受定型几何配方的约束,纯重建框架内在缺乏基因想象力,经常产生严重的视觉文物,模糊不清或空洞的空隙,在大镜头运动下合成未观测到的区域.

blocks.en:
To compensate for the limited extrapolation capability of reconstruction methods, video diffusion models have recently been repurposed for view synthesis ( Yu et al., 2024a ) , leveraging rich appearance priors learned from vast video corpora ( Wan et al., 2025 ) .
Despite their expressive completion, applying video models directly or sequentially to 3D scenes often accumulates cross-frame inconsistencies, causing drift and structural breakdown over long horizons ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
To enforce spatial consistency, hybrid frameworks align video diffusion features with 3D representations ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , yet they remain burdened by the heavy computational overhead of synthesizing dense video frames. More recently, Geometry Latent Diffusion (GLD) ( Jang et al., 2026 ) has emerged as a promising alternative that generates novel views directly within a geometric latent space. Built upon 3D foundation models such as DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , which is pretrained on large-scale data with depth and camera-pose supervision to learn cross-view attention, this space provides a robust structural foundation and a geometric prior for single-pass consistency. Furthermore, GLD’s RGB head effectively decodes fine texture and appearance details from these features ( Jang et al., 2026 ) . However, restricted by a limited training distribution, GLD struggles with generative fidelity and stability on in-the-wild scenes.
blocks.zh:
为了补偿重建方法的有限推断能力,最近重新将视频传播模型用于视图合成(Yu等人,2024年a),利用从庞大的视频公司(Wan等人,2025年)中吸取的丰富的外观前身。
尽管其表现性完成,但将视频模型直接或相继应用到3D场景中,往往会累积跨帧不一致,导致漂移和结构在长视野上崩溃(Wu等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年).
为了实现空间一致性,混合框架将视频传播特征与3D表达一致(Wu等人,2025年;Huang等人,2026年),然而它们仍然受到合成密集视频帧的沉重计算管理负担. 最近,几何底线扩散(GLD)(Jang等人,2026年)作为一种有希望的替代方法出现,在几何潜伏空间内直接产生新的观点。 该空间以DA3(Lin等人,2025年)等3D基础模型为基础,在具有深度和相机前置监控的大型数据上进行预训,以学习交叉视野的注意度,该空间为单通道一致性提供了坚实的结构基础和几何前置. 此外,GLD的RGB头有效解码了这些特征的精细纹理和外观细节(Jang等人,2026年). 然而,受有限的培训分配的限制,一般法律司在全局场景中与基因忠诚和稳定性发生斗争。

blocks.en:
In summary, existing NVS approaches struggle to seamlessly harmonize rigid 3D geometric consistency with expressively detailed generative completion.
To bridge this gap, we present GeoVerse , a novel framework that endows geometric latent diffusion with rich video generative priors while maintaining structural consistency via a persistent spatial memory.
We address these limitations through three key designs. First, we incorporate Wan2.2 VACE ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025b ) , a high-capacity video diffusion model pretrained on extensive video data, to enrich the geometric latent space with powerful appearance priors and plausible scene completion. Second, we scale the 3D training corpus from 4 to 15 diverse real and synthetic datasets to broaden scene coverage and enhance cross-domain generalization.
Beyond single-pass consistency, successive view expansion requires a persistent representation across multiple inference steps. Inspired by ViewCrafter ( Yu et al., 2024a ) , we maintain a global colored point-cloud memory that accumulates historical content. Reprojecting this memory into target views provides pixel-aligned guidance, anchoring multi-step predictions while facilitating unobserved region completion. Leveraging this structured guidance, we employ reflow distillation ( Yan et al., 2024 ) to reduce the denoising process to 4 steps, cutting per-inference latency from over 100 seconds to under 10 seconds.
blocks.zh:
简而言之,现有的NVS方法试图将刚性3D几何一致性与表达性的详细基因完成无缝协调起来。
为了弥合这一差距,我们介绍了GeoVerse, 这是一种新颖的框架,它通过丰富的视频基因前传赋予几何潜在扩散,同时通过持续的空间记忆保持结构一致性。
我们通过三个关键设计来解决这些局限性。 首先,我们加入了Wan2.2 VACE(Wan等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2025年b),这是一个在广泛的视频数据上预先训练的高容量视频传播模型,以强大的外观前身和可信的场景完成来丰富几何潜伏空间。 第二,我们把3D训练套件从4个扩大到15个不同的真实和合成数据集,以扩大场景覆盖面和加强跨域的概括。
除了单通道一致性外,连续的视图扩展需要持续地通过多个推论步骤进行表达. 受ViewCrafter(Yu et al., 2024a)启发,我们保持了全球彩色点云记忆,积累了历史内容. 将这个内存重新投射到目标视图中,提供了像素对齐的指引,锁定了多步骤的预测,同时方便了未观察的区域完成. 利用这种结构化的制导,我们采用回流蒸馏法(Yan等人,2024年),将去诺化过程减少到4个步骤,将推论延迟度从100秒以上减少到10秒以下.

blocks.en: Our primary contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce a novel framework that seamlessly bridges geometric latent diffusion with expressive video generative priors for world-consistent novel view synthesis. • We propose a global spatial memory mechanism that provides target-aligned input guidance, effectively enforcing sustained long-sequence geometric consistency across extended trajectories without cumulative drift. • We scale up model training across diverse real and synthetic multi-view corpora to significantly enhance cross-domain generalization and integrate a few-step reflow distillation scheme to significantly accelerate inference to under 10 seconds.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们引入了一个新颖的框架,它无缝地将几何潜在传播与表达式视频基因前传连接在一起,用于世界一致的新视觉合成。 我们建议建立一个全球空间记忆机制,提供目标对齐的输入指导,在没有累积漂移的延伸轨迹中有效保证持续的长期序列几何一致性。 我们扩大跨不同真实和合成的多视公司模型培训,以大大加强跨域泛化,整合几步回流蒸馏计划,大大加快推导到10秒以下.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Reconstructive Novel View Synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.1 重建小说视图综合

blocks.en: Focusing on fusing existing scene content within captured view bounds, reconstructive novel view synthesis was initially dominated by scene-specific optimization. Pioneered by NeRF ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ) , implicit radiance fields achieved novel view rendering through differentiable volume rendering, which was later accelerated and scaled by subsequent variants ( Barron et al., 2021 ; Müller et al., 2022 ) . To overcome the implicit rendering bottleneck, 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) introduced explicit 3D Gaussian primitives for real-time synthesis, followed by improvements in anti-aliasing and geometry modeling ( Yu et al., 2024b ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2024 ) . While capable of rendering high-fidelity views, these per-scene representations suffer from long optimization times and strictly require dense multi-view coverage. To bypass per-scene optimization, feed-forward frameworks learn generalizable mappings from sparse inputs to novel target views. Early generalizable architectures like MVSplat ( Chen et al., 2024 ) leverage plane-sweep cost volumes for 3D Gaussian prediction, while LVSM ( Jin et al., 2024 ) scales transformer-based synthesis with minimal explicit geometric priors. Accelerated by 3D foundation models like VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , recent frameworks seamlessly unify camera estimation and feed-forward reconstruction. Specifically, AnySplat ( Jiang et al., 2025a ) jointly recovers camera poses and 3D Gaussians from unconstrained views, whereas WorldMirror ( Liu et al., 2025 ) incorporates multi-source geometric priors. In the monocular regime, SHARP ( Mescheder et al., 2026 ) regresses a metric 3D Gaussian field from a single image in one forward pass. Although feed-forward methods excel at interpolative synthesis within bounded views, extrapolating to unobserved regions remains inherently ambiguous.
blocks.zh: 注重在捕捉到的视野界限内对已有的场景内容进行引信处理,重建小说景观合成最初以场景特定优化为主. NERF的先锋(Mildenhall等人,2021年),暗含的光线场通过可分量渲染实现新视觉渲染,后来被后续变体加速和缩放(Barron等人,2021年;Müller等人,2022年). 为了克服隐含的渲染瓶颈,3DGS(Kerbl等人,2023年)引入了明确的3D高斯原始物进行实时合成,之后在反异形和几何模型的改进(Yu等人,2024b;Lu等人,2024年;Ren等人,2024年). 这些场景代表物虽然能够渲染出高真实性的观点,但长期处于优化期,严格要求密集的多景覆盖. 为了绕过每个场景的优化,向导框架学习从稀少的投入到新的目标视图的通用绘图. MVSplate(Chen等人,2024年)等早期通用建筑为3D高斯预测提供了杠杆平面-扫荡成本量,而LVSM(Jin等人,2024年)基于变压器的合成只有最小的显式几何前缀. 由VGGT(Wang et al., 2025a)等3D基础模型加速,最近的框架无缝地统一了相机估计和饲料前进重建. 具体来说,AnySplate(Jiang等人,2025年a)联合回收了相机姿势和3D 高斯人来自不受约束的观点,而WorldMirror(Liu等人,2025年)则包含了多源几何前传. 在单体制度下,SHARP(Mescheder等人,2026年)将一个标定的3D高斯场从一个前传的单一图像中倒退. 虽然饲料法在有限观点范围内的插图合成方面很出色,但推断到未观测到的区域仍然内在模糊不清。

blocks.en: 2.2 Generative Novel View Synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.2 基因小说视图合成

blocks.en: Generative novel view synthesis introduces generative priors to synthesize content beyond the observed scene coverage. ViewCrafter combines point-based 3D clues with a pretrained video diffusion model and iteratively expands both its camera trajectory and reconstructed content ( Yu et al., 2024a ) . NeoVerse couples feed-forward 4D reconstruction with novel-trajectory video generation to model scenes from in-the-wild monocular videos ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . To reduce drift over longer horizons, spatial-memory approaches explicitly store and retrieve previously generated scene content: geometry-grounded long-term memory caches 3D history, while Mirage lifts diffusion latents into a persistent 3D cache and queries it through latent-space warping ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Lyra 2.0 combines per frame geometric matching for history retrieval with self augmented history training to suppress cumulative drift during long sequence generation ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . These methods improve long-horizon consistency while retaining a video-based generation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 基因小说视角合成引入基因前传,以合成超出观测场景覆盖范围的内容. ViewCrafter将基于点的3D线索与预先训练的视频传播模型相结合,并迭代扩展其相机轨迹和重构内容(Yu等人,2024a). NeoVerse情侣向前进的4D重建,以小说传导视频生成为模式,从内向单曲视频(杨等人,2026年). 为了减少漂移越长的视野,空间记忆方法明确存储和检索先前产生的场景内容:几何定位的长期内存缓存3D历史,而幻影将潜伏的潜伏物移入一个持久的3D缓存,并通过潜伏空间扭曲进行查询(Wu等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年). Lyra 2.0将每个帧的几何匹配用于历史检索与自我增强的历史训练相结合,以抑制长序列生成过程中的累积漂移(Shen等人,2026年). 这些方法提高了长视距一致性,同时保留了基于视频的生成管道.

blocks.en: Geometric foundation models offer a complementary route to geometry-aware extrapolation. Geometry Forcing supervises intermediate video-diffusion representations with features from a geometric foundation model, while Gen3R adapts VGGT tokens into geometric latents and aligns them with pretrained video appearance latents for joint RGB and 3D generation ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Although these methods improve the 3D awareness of video diffusion, their generation process remains organized as a video sequence. Geometric Latent Diffusion (GLD) instead repurposes the geometric feature space of DA3 as the native latent space for multi-view diffusion, enabling direct generation at specified target cameras with strong cross-view correspondence ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Jang et al., 2026 ) . Unlike prior sequence-based approaches, GeoVerse adopts the geometric-latent formulation, augmented by video generative priors and a persistent 3D memory, enabling direct target-view synthesis free of dense video interpolation.
blocks.zh: 几何基础模型为几何感知推算提供了一条补充路线. 几何强化监督具有几何基础模型特征的中间视频扩散表示,而GEN3R则将VGGT令牌调整为几何潜质,并与预训视频外观潜质配合,用于联合RGB和3D生成(Wu等人,2025年;Huang等人,2026年). 虽然这些方法提高了视频传播的3D意识,但其生成过程仍作为视频序列组织. 几何Latent Difusion(GLD)改用DA3的几何特征空间作为多视图传播的原生潜在空间,使特定目标相机能够直接生成具有强烈交叉视图对应的图像(Lin等人,2025年;Jang等人,2026年)。 与之前的序列法不同,GeoVerse采用了几何相对配体,辅以视频基因前传和持续的3D内存,使得直接的目标视图合成没有密集的视频插值.

blocks.en: 3.1 Enhancing Geometric Latent Diffusion with Video Priors
blocks.zh: 3.1 增强带视频前传的几何线性扩散

blocks.en: Geometry Latent Space. Standard image-video latent spaces provide robust appearance priors but struggle to maintain explicit 3D correspondence across novel viewpoints ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) . In contrast, GLD combines the geometry head of Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) for spatial layouts (depth and raymaps) with an auxiliary RGB head for high-frequency textures ( Jang et al., 2026 ) . To maintain multi-round scene consistency, GeoVerse incrementally updates a colored point-cloud memory 𝐌 r \mathbf{M}^{r} in a shared coordinate system ( Yu et al., 2024a ; Ren et al., 2025 ) . Context observations initialize the memory as 𝐌 0 = 𝐏 0 \mathbf{M}^{0}=\mathbf{P}^{0} using DA3-predicted ( Lin et al., 2025 ) or metric depth if available. For generated rounds, predicted depth is scale-aligned via 𝐃 ~ i r = s r ⋆ ​ 𝐃 i r ^ \widetilde{\mathbf{D}}_{i}^{r}=s_{r}^{\star}\hat{\mathbf{D}_{i}^{r}} using a camera-center similarity transform. blocks.en:
We evaluate on two in-domain benchmarks, RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) and DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) , and two out-of-domain benchmarks, Mip-NeRF 360 ( Barron et al., 2022 ) and ScanNetv2 ( Dai et al., 2017 ) , with ScanNetv2 used for long-sequence evaluation.
Specifically, each generation round uses N 𝒞 = 2 N_{\mathcal{C}}=2 context views and N 𝒯 = 6 N_{\mathcal{T}}=6 target views.
We report PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) for visual quality, ATE and relative pose errors ( RPE r \mathrm{RPE}_{\mathrm{r}} / RPE t \mathrm{RPE}_{\mathrm{t}} ) ( Sturm et al., 2012 ) from VGGT-estimated poses ( Wang et al., 2025a ) for target-camera fidelity, reprojection error and MEt3R ( Asim et al., 2025 ) for cross-view geometric and feature consistency, and average inference time for efficiency.

我们评价两个域内基准:RealEstate10K(周等人,2018年)和DL3DV(Ling等人,2024年),以及两个域外基准:Mip-NERF 360(Barron等人,2022年)和ScanNetv2(Dai等人,2017年),其中ScanNetv2用于长序评价.

We compare with ViewCrafter ( Yu et al., 2024a ) , NeoVerse ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , GEN3C ( Ren et al., 2025 ) , MVGenMaster ( Cao et al., 2025 ) , Matrix3D ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , CAMEO ( Kwon et al., 2025 ) , and GLD ( Jang et al., 2026 ) , covering diverse approaches to generative novel-view synthesis.
For long-sequence evaluation, we compare with ViewCrafter, NeoVerse, GEN3C, and GLD across successive rounds to assess visual quality and cross-round consistency.

blocks.en: Starting from a pretrained GLD ( Jang et al., 2026 ) , GeoVerse is trained on 15 real and synthetic multi-view datasets using DA3-Base ( Lin et al., 2025 ) at 504 × 504 504\times 504 resolution, with eight ordered views per sample (one to four selected as context views). Training proceeds in two stages: a 300k-iteration adaptation phase with a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , followed by up to 50k iterations of reflow distillation at 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} . Both stages are executed on 32 NVIDIA A800 GPUs using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) with a global batch size of 32. Adaptation hyperparameters are set to ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) , gradient-norm clipping at 1.0, and an EMA decay of 0.9995. Further details are provided in Appendix D .

blocks.en: GeoVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance across all four benchmarks in Tab. 1 , surpassing GLD ( Jang et al., 2026 ) in PSNR by 2.23 dB on DL3DV and 2.45 dB on Mip-NeRF 360. These gains translate into clear visual improvements (Fig. 3 ), effectively suppressing smearing and ghosting while recovering crisp object boundaries and faithful surface colors relative to context views. Unlike baselines that introduce misplaced structures or color shifts, GeoVerse preserves scene identity during synthesis. On long-sequence ScanNetv2 testing across three rounds, GeoVerse boosts PSNR from 15.33 dB (GLD) to 19.65 dB, maintaining temporal stability across large indoor structures.
blocks.zh: GeoVerse在Tab中实现所有四个基准的最新业绩。 1,在PSNR中以DL3DV上的2.23 dB和Mip-NERF360上的2.45 dB超过了GLD(Jang等人,2026年). 这些成果转化为清晰的视觉改进(图3),有效抑制抹黑和幽灵,同时恢复与上下文相对的清晰物体界限和忠实的表面颜色。 与引入错位结构或色彩变化的基线不同,GeoVerse在合成过程中保留了场景身份. 在经过三轮的长序ScanNetv2测试中,GeoVerse将PSNR从15.33 dB(GLD)提升到19.65 dB,保持了跨大型室内结构的时间稳定性.

blocks.en: GeoVerse lowers ATE on Mip-NeRF 360 from 0.105 (GLD ( Jang et al., 2026 ) ) to 0.071, representing a 32.4% improvement. As reflected in Tab. 1 and Fig. 3 , lower pose errors manifest as enhanced 3D structural fidelity, preserving intricate geometry like outdoor furniture without distortion. Over long sequences, key scene elements retain cross-round consistency, avoiding the structural repetitions and layout shifts prevalent in baselines. This validates the role of persistent spatial memory in anchoring new updates to accumulated context. While performance varies slightly across specific metrics, where some baselines achieve lower reprojection or translation errors on individual datasets, GeoVerse maintains significantly better global scene coherence.
blocks.zh: GeoVerse在Mip-NERF 360上将ATE从0.105(GLD(Jang等人,2026年))降到0.071,代表32.4%的改进. 如Tab.1和图3所示,下方的误差显示为增强的三维结构忠贞性,保留了复杂的几何学,如室外家具而不扭曲。 在较长的序列中,关键场景元素保持了跨圆一致性,避免了基线中普遍存在的结构重复和布局变化. 这验证了持续空间内存在将新的更新锁定到累积上下文方面的作用. 虽然具体衡量标准的表现略有不同,有些基线在单个数据集上实现了较低的再预测或翻译错误,但GeoVerse保持了显著更好的全球场景一致性。

blocks.en: GeoVerse synthesizes six target views in roughly nine seconds across the three main benchmarks, operating about 18 × 18\times faster than GLD ( Jang et al., 2026 ) . This acceleration stems from using only four geometric denoising steps paired with single-pass video feature extraction. Even under this constrained sampling budget, generated outputs maintain crisp object contours and recognizable 3D geometry. This efficiency advantage naturally carries over to sequential view expansion, as each additional round employs the same compact pipeline. Per-pass runtimes for the main benchmarks and cumulative three-round times on ScanNetv2 are summarized in Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh: GeoVerse在大约9秒内将6个目标视图合成了三大基准,运行速度比GLD(Jang等人,2026年)快约18×18\时. 这种加速度来源于只使用四个几何脱诺步骤与单路视频特性提取对齐. 即使在这种有限的采样预算下,产生的产出仍保持了清晰的物体轮廓和可识别的三维几何。 这种效率优势自然延续到相继的视野扩展,因为每多一轮都使用同样的紧凑管道。 ScanNetv2上的主要基准和累计三轮运行时间的通过时间摘要载于Tab。 1 (英语).

blocks.en: 4.3 Few-Step Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 几步分析

blocks.en: We analyze the denoising budget within GLD’s hierarchical sampling framework ( Jang et al., 2026 ) , with Level-1 acceleration based on reflow ( Yan et al., 2024 ) . Table 2 evaluates denoising budget trade offs on DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) . Reducing Level-1 generation from three steps to one lowers runtime from 9.24 to 6.07 s, yet worsens LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) from 0.339 to 0.367. As shown in Fig. 4 , this setting causes a loss of fine brick textures and object boundaries despite higher PSNR, showing that PSNR alone fails to reflect perceptual quality. On the other hand, cutting Level 0 cascade steps from 49 to one preserves comparable local details with an LPIPS of 0.342 versus 0.339 at much lower latency. These complementary trends validate our 3 + 1 3+1 budget allocation.
blocks.zh: 我们分析GLD的分级采样框架(Jang等人, 2026年)范围内的去诺化预算, 表2评估了DL3DV(Ling等人,2024年)的预算交易。 将一级发电由9.24秒降低到6.07秒,从3步降低到1步,然而LPIPS(张等人,2018年)则从0.339降至0.367. 如图4所示,尽管PSNR较高,但这种设置仍然造成精细的砖质纹理和物体边界的丧失,表明单PSNR无法反映知觉质量. 另一方面,将0级级级阶梯从49级切割到1级,保留了可比较的局部细节,在低得多的延迟度下,LPIPS为0.342比0.339。 这些相辅相成的趋势证实了我们3+1、3+1的预算拨款。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes diagnostic ablations on ScanNetv2 Dai et al. (2017) across model components and supervision losses. (1) Removing the Wan2.2 Wan et al. (2025) video prior causes the most severe visual degradation, proving that video appearance priors are essential for synthesizing faithful content. (2) Disabling spatial memory substantially degrades both visual fidelity and cross view alignment, highlighting the importance of accumulated scene context for multi round consistency. (3) The Mixture of Transformers variant explores key value attention as an alternative to additive residual injection, though isolating its relative advantages requires comparison under matched training settings. (4) Omitting RGB supervision leads to a moderate decline in visual quality, showing that direct appearance supervision complements the video prior. (5) Removing depth supervision weakens overall geometric consistency and confirms the value of explicit structural constraints, though non uniform metric variations indicate nuanced geometric trade offs.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: While GeoVerse achieves strong multi-view consistency and high inference efficiency, two main limitations remain. First, its peak visual fidelity is constrained by the appearance capacity of the DA3 feature space. By prioritizing speed through compact feature conditioning, GeoVerse may not fully match the fine texture richness of computationally heavy, full-scale video diffusion models. Second, multi-round consistency depends on both the underlying geometry backbone and synthesized RGB coherence. In textureless or complex regions, initial depth errors and generated appearance drift can accumulate through spatial memory updates, occasionally compromising cross-view alignment across long trajectories. Improving joint 3D geometric and photometric stability remains a key objective for future research.
blocks.zh: 虽然GeoVerse实现了强烈的多视图一致性和高推论效率,但两个主要局限性依然存在. 首先,它的峰值视觉忠贞性受到DA3特征空间的外观能力的限制. GeoVerse通过紧凑的特性调制来优先处理速度,可能无法完全匹配计算重的全尺寸视频传播模型的精细纹理丰富度. 第二,多轮一致性既取决于基本的几何骨干,也取决于合成的RGB一致性. 在无纹或复杂区域,初始深度误差和生成的外观漂移可以通过空间内存更新积累,偶尔会损害跨长轨的交叉视距对齐. 提高三维几何和光度稳定性仍然是未来研究的一个关键目标。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced GeoVerse, a framework designed to resolve the fundamental trade off between geometric consistency and generative completion in novel view synthesis. By embedding pretrained video appearance priors into a 3D geometric latent diffusion model, GeoVerse generates high fidelity views while maintaining rigid spatial structure. Our global spatial memory further prevents cumulative drift across extended trajectories by grounding ongoing synthesis in accumulated 3D scene context. Accelerated by a few step reflow distillation scheme, GeoVerse achieves over 17 times speedup compared to GLD while setting new state of the art benchmarks in visual quality and pose accuracy. By demonstrating the effectiveness of combining video learned priors with geometric latent spaces, GeoVerse establishes a robust foundation and offers valuable insights toward building multi view consistent video world models.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了GeoVerse, 这个框架旨在解决几何一致性与新视角合成中的基因完成之间的根本交易。 GeoVerse通过将预先训练的视频外观前缀嵌入到3D几何潜扩散模型中,生成高忠诚度的视图,同时保持刚性空间结构. 我们的全球空间记忆通过在累积的三维场景背景下地面进行不断合成,进一步防止了扩展轨迹的累积漂移。 GeoVerse通过几步回流蒸馏计划加速,与GLD相比,GeoVerse实现了超过17倍的加速,同时设定了视觉质量的新水平的艺术基准,并呈现出准确性. GeoVerse通过展示将所学到的视频前科与几何潜伏空间相结合的有效性,为建立多视图一致的视频世界模型奠定了坚实的基础,并提供了宝贵的见解。

blocks.en: Appendix A Wan2.2 VACE Details
blocks.zh: 附录A Wan2.2 VACE 详情

blocks.en: Wan is a video diffusion framework with a causal video VAE, a text encoder, and a diffusion Transformer ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . In the standard generation pipeline, the Transformer iteratively denoises a video latent under text and optional visual conditions, and the VAE decoder converts the final latent into RGB frames. Visual inputs requiring latent encoding are processed by the VAE encoder before entering the corresponding conditioning path. Wan2.2-A14B uses separate high- and low-noise experts for different portions of the denoising trajectory, with approximately 14 billion active parameters per step.
blocks.zh: Wan是一个带因果视频VAE,文本编码器,以及传播变形器的视频传播框架(Wan等人,2025年). 在标准生成管道中,变形器迭代地在文本和可选视觉条件下将一个视频潜伏,VAE解码器将最终潜伏转换成RGB帧. 需要潜伏编码的视觉输入在进入相应的条件路径之前由VAE编码器处理. Wan2.2-A14B对去声轨迹的不同部分使用单独的高噪和低噪专家,每步活性参数约为140亿.

blocks.en: VACE ( Jiang et al., 2025b ) adds a unified interface for reference images, source videos, and spatiotemporal masks. Its Video Condition Unit organizes these inputs for reference-guided generation, video editing, inpainting, outpainting, and temporal extension. The standard VACE pipeline tokenizes visual conditions through context encoding and introduces them into the video backbone through context adapters. Its training curriculum progresses from foundational completion tasks to multiple references and task combinations, followed by quality refinement. These components provide visual completion cues that complement the geometric representation used by GeoVerse.
blocks.zh: VACE (Jiang et al., 2025b) 增加了一个参考图像,源视频,以及spatiopal口罩的统一界面. 它的视频条件 该股为参考指导生成、视频编辑、油漆、外涂和时间扩展组织这些投入。 标准的VACE管道通过上下文编码来表示视觉条件,并通过上下文适配器将它们引入视频主干线. 其培训课程从基础性完成任务发展到多种参考和任务组合,然后进行质量改进。 这些组件提供了视觉完成提示,补充了GeoVerse使用的几何表示.

blocks.en: The Wan technical report describes pretraining on billions of images and videos ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . The Wan2.2 release reports 65.6% more images and 83.2% more videos than Wan2.1; these are relative increases, rather than disclosed absolute counts for the Wan2.2 corpus. VACE constructs task-specific conditions from filtered videos, including segmentation masks, reference crops, depth, pose, and optical flow ( Jiang et al., 2025b ) . The available model card does not specify an absolute training-set size for the particular Wan2.2-VACE-Fun checkpoint used here. These external pretraining corpora are separate from GeoVerse’s multi-view training data in Sec. D .
blocks.zh: Wan技术报告描述了对数十亿图像和视频的预先培训(Wan等人,2025年)。 Wan2.2的发布报告图像比Wan2.1多65.6%,视频多83.2%;这些是相对的增加,而不是披露Wan2.2的绝对数字。 VACE通过过滤的视频构建任务特定条件,包括分片口罩,参考作物,深度,姿势,以及光学流(Jiang等人,2025年b). 现有的型号卡没有为此处使用的Wan2.2-VACE-Fun检查站指定绝对的训练设置大小. 这些外部预训公司与GeoVerse在Sec.D的多视图训练数据分开.

blocks.zh: 附录C 视频前置注射的 MoT 变式

blocks.en: Following the shared-attention design of Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , we couple video-prior tokens and geometric latent tokens through attention while retaining separate processing streams. At each coupled layer, modality-specific projections map the two representations into a common attention space. The geometric stream produces queries, keys, and values from its current denoising state, while the video stream supplies visual keys and values. We concatenate the video and geometric keys and values along the token dimension, allowing each geometric query to attend jointly to scene features and video priors. The resulting attention output passes through the geometric stream’s output projection, residual connection, and feed-forward layers to update its tokens.
blocks.zh: 在Fast-WAM(Yuan et al., 2026)的共享设计之后,我们通过注意,同时保留单独的处理流,对视频前兆和几何潜兆进行配对. 在每个对接层上,特定模式的预测将两种表述映射成共同的注意力空间. 几何流产生来自其当前去诺状态的查询,密钥和值,而视频流则提供视觉密钥和值. 我们把视频和几何键和值 沿着符号维度, 允许每个几何查询 一起到场景特征和视频前传。 由此产生的注意力输出通过几何流的输出投影,剩余连接,以及向导层来更新其信号.

blocks.en: The interaction is asymmetric: geometric tokens attend to the video stream, while video features remain independent of the evolving geometric state. We therefore compute and cache the video keys and values once, reusing them across denoising updates. Geometric queries, keys, and values are recomputed at each step. This variant introduces video information within the attention computation, whereas the ControlNet-style design injects it through an auxiliary residual branch.
blocks.zh: 互动是不对称的:几何符号关注视频流,而视频特征仍然独立于不断发展的几何状态. 因此,我们计算并缓存了一次视频密钥和值,再通过调试更新加以使用。 几何查询、密钥和值在每一步重算。 这个变体在注意力计算中引入了视频信息,而ControlNet风格的设计则通过一个辅助剩余分支注入.

blocks.en: Appendix D Training Data and Statistics
blocks.zh: 附录D 培训数据和统计

blocks.en: Our training mixture contains 15 datasets spanning real indoor captures, outdoor videos, driving sequences, and synthetic environments. TartanAir and TartanAir v2 are listed separately as distinct sampling sources. Table 4 follows the dataset/type/count presentation of DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , but reports our own training-manifest and RGB-inventory statistics rather than DA3’s differently selected subsets. MegaDepth is excluded from this mixture.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练混合物包含15个数据集 包括真正的室内捕捉 室外视频 驱动序列 和合成环境 塔尔塔奈尔和塔尔坦 空气v2单独列为不同的采样来源. 表4沿用了DA3(Lin等人,2025年)的数据集/类型/计算方式,但报告的是我们自己的训练说明和RGB库存统计,而不是DA3不同选择的子集。 这种混合物不包括大深度。

blocks.en: We sample dataset sources with probabilities proportional to the square root of their RGB frame counts, balancing coverage against the dominance of the largest collections. RealEstate10K and Waymo use Pi3-estimated poses and depth ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . For the remaining sources, available dataset geometry and Pi3-estimated geometry are selected at a nominal ratio of 2 : 1 2:1 ; samples with missing or incomplete depth fall back to Pi3. Samples that fail loading or validity checks are resampled. The inventory counts therefore describe the available training pool, not the number of distinct images consumed by a completed run.
blocks.zh: 我们抽取了与RGB框架计数的平方根成正比概率的数据集源,平衡了覆盖范围和最大收藏的主导地位. RealEstate10K和Waymo使用Pi3估计的姿势和深度(Wang等人,2025b). 对于其余来源,现有数据集几何学和Pi3估计几何学的标称比为2:1;缺少或不完整深度的样本回落到Pi3. 无法装入或有效性检查的样本将重新取样。 因此,盘点清单描述了现有的培训人才库,而不是一个已完成的运行所消耗的不同图像的数量。
